svg.title: Input-to-variation audio spectral masking pipeline
svg.desc: Complete native SVG reconstruction. Base frames: input panel with waveform or spectrogram, encoder hourglass, DFT, latent spectrum box, user/random mask arrows, masked spectrum box, inverse DFT, decoder hourglass, variation panel, and dashed red add-noise/reconstruction-loss feedback. Conduction origin is the left input panel; content proceeds left-to-right through encoder, DFT, latent spectrum, masks, masked spectrum, inverse DFT, decoder, and variation output, with lower dashed feedback paths returning toward the input. Symmetry basis: horizontal pipeline alignment through the centerline y≈122; input and variation panels mirror each other in scale and internal layout.
